usage.outputShape: body.translated_text (string); body.source_language (auto-detected), body.target_language, body.confidence; meta under body._meta
quirks: Params go in the query string, not a JSON body (GET request).
target_language and text are required; source_language is optional and auto-detected.
target_language accepts language names like 'Swedish', 'English', 'French' (not just ISO codes).
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.strale.io/x402/translate with query params text (the text to translate) and target_language (a language name like 'Swedish' or 'French'); source_language is optional and auto-detected. Pay via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.054/call). Read the result from body.translated_text; body.source_language reports the detected source and body.confidence the quality. Plain synchronous response, no auth or polling needed.
